column3: MT 46:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1 and adds “A Psalm”; “a help in troubles, found exceedingly” is rendered “A very present help in trouble.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seas” is rendered “sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “Though” twice and “pride.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “There is,” and renders “the holy place of the dwellings” as “The holy dwelling places.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at the turning of the morning” is rendered “when morning dawns.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a refuge” (high place) is rendered “our stronghold.”
Close to the Hebrew; “carts” is rendered “chariots.”
